result.rationale: The diff shows refreshOAuthTokens returns the raw fetch Response from CALCOM_CREDENTIAL_SYNC_ENDPOINT, while GoogleCalendarService does `const token = res?.data; token.access_token`, expecting google-auth-library's `{res, data}` shape. A fetch Response has no `.data`, so in sync mode `token` is undefined and `token.access_token` throws, breaking Google refresh.

adjudication.rationale: In `packages/app-store/googlecalendar/lib/CalendarService.ts`, `refreshAccessToken` now calls `refreshOAuthTokens(...)` and then does `const token = res?.data;` followed by `token.access_token`/`token.expiry_date`. But in sync mode (`APP_CREDENTIAL_SHARING_ENABLED && CALCOM_CREDENTIAL_SYNC_ENDPOINT && userId`), `refreshOAuthTokens` returns the raw `fetch(...)` `Response` object (see `packages/app-store/_utils/oauth/refreshOAuthTokens.ts`), which does not have a `.data` property. That makes `token` undefined and `token.access_token` will throw at runtime, breaking refresh flow when sync mode is enabled.
